review_candidates.description: Vice President – People (UAEN) Location: Abu Dhabi (Onsite – Mussafah) About the Opportunity Our client, a leading manufacturing organization in the region, is seeking an accomplished Vice President – People to provide strategic leadership across the full spectrum of Human Capital, Administration, and Corporate Services. Reporting to the executive leadership team, this role will shape the organization's people strategy, drive organizational transformation, and ensure the delivery of world-class HR and shared services that support long-term business growth. This is a highly visible executive leadership role responsible for aligning people strategy with business objectives, leading organizational development, driving Emiratization, and overseeing employee services, facilities, and administration across a large, complex industrial environment. Key Responsibilities Executive Leadership & Strategy • Serve as a member of the Executive Management team, contributing to the development and execution of corporate strategy and long-term business objectives. • Develop and implement the annual operating plan and strategic roadmap for the People and Corporate Services function. • Lead enterprise-wide organizational transformation and change management initiatives that improve business performance and organizational effectiveness. • Define and execute the overall Human Capital strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and future workforce requirements. • Establish an effective organizational structure that supports operational excellence, scalability, and business growth. • Lead annual workforce planning and budgeting, ensuring effective resource allocation and cost optimization. • Oversee divisional budgets, financial performance, and productivity while ensuring efficient utilization of resources. People & Culture • Develop and implement people strategies that attract, develop, engage, and retain high-performing talent. • Lead workforce planning, talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership development, learning and development, and organizational capability initiatives. • Drive company-wide performance management frameworks aligned with business objectives. • Oversee compensation, benefits, rewards, recognition, and employee wellbeing strategies to ensure competitiveness and regulatory compliance. • Champion employee engagement, culture transformation, diversity, inclusion, and employer branding initiatives. • Develop and oversee grievance management, employee relations, and conflict resolution frameworks. • Ensure HR policies, governance, and employment practices remain compliant with local Labour Law and applicable regulations. • Lead the company's Emiratization strategy, ensuring achievement of government targets while building sustainable talent pipelines. Administration & Corporate Services • Provide executive oversight of corporate administration and employee services. • Lead Facilities and Services operations, including accommodation, transportation, catering, reception, security, mail services, clinic operations, maintenance, landscaping, cleaning, and other employee support services. • Ensure service excellence through effective vendor management, service level agreements, and continuous performance improvement. • Identify outsourcing opportunities and manage strategic partnerships to improve efficiency while maintaining service quality and cost effectiveness. Technology & Continuous Improvement • Drive the adoption of technology and digital HR solutions to improve operational efficiency and employee experience. • Evaluate HR systems, analytics platforms, and automation opportunities to enhance decision making and workforce insights. • Develop meaningful people analytics and executive dashboards to support strategic workforce planning. Leadership & Governance • Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing leadership team across Human Capital and Corporate Services. • Establish clear KPIs and accountability frameworks for departmental leaders. • Represent the People function at Executive Committee meetings and provide strategic advice to senior leadership. • Foster collaboration across business functions while driving a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. Health, Safety & Compliance • Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with EHS legislation and organizational policies. • Ensure all People and Corporate Services activities comply with applicable legal, regulatory, governance, and internal audit requirements. • Maintain effective relationships with regulatory authorities, government entities, and external stakeholders. Experience • Minimum 15 years of progressive Human Resources leadership experience, including significant executive-level responsibility. • Proven leadership experience within manufacturing, industrial, engineering, heavy industry, or similarly complex operational environments. • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide Human Capital transformation initiatives. • Extensive experience across talent acquisition, organizational development, performance management, compensation and benefits, employee relations, learning and development, and administration. • Proven experience leading Emiratization strategies and workforce nationalization initiatives. • Strong commercial acumen with responsibility for large operational budgets and vendor management. • Experience managing shared services including facilities, administration, and employee support functions is highly desirable. Key Competencies • Executive leadership and strategic thinking. • Strong commercial and financial acumen. • Organizational transformation and change management expertise. • Deep understanding of local Labour Law and the Emiratization landscape. • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills. • Data-driven decision making and workforce analytics capability. • Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills. • High levels of integrity, professionalism, and discretion. • Ability to lead large, multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced industrial environment. • Fluency in English is essential. Arabic is highly preferred. Key Performance Indicators • Employee engagement and organizational culture. • Employee satisfaction across People and Corporate Services. • Achievement of Emiratization targets. • Talent attraction, retention, and succession readiness. • Leadership capability and workforce productivity. • Accuracy and effective utilization of divisional budgets. • Compensation and overhead cost management. • Service quality and operational efficiency across corporate services. • Compliance with HR policies, governance, and legislative requirements. • Internal and external audit performance. • Vendor performance, service quality, and cost optimization. • Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental compliance. Working Arrangement This is a fully onsite executive leadership position based at the client's Head Office in Mussafah, Abu Dhabi.

Research products, customer motivations, objections, competitors, and social trends, then turn those insights into clear creative ideas. Edit short-form ads and branded content for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Combine creator footage, product assets, and AI-generated scenes with strong pacing, persuasive storytelling, captions, and clear calls to action. Create realistic AI UGC-style content with believable people, expressions, gestures, product interactions, and lip sync. Direct voice delivery and sound design so dialogue, music, and visuals work together naturally. Produce AI product videos and motion graphics using reference images, controlled generation, compositing, animation, and kinetic typography. Preserve product shape, scale, packaging, labels, and visual consistency across shots. Develop organic social concepts with strong openings, humor, relevant memes, cultural references, and repeatable formats. Adapt trends to each brand and audience, with a focus on retention, sharing, and discovery. Build meaningful variations of hooks, angles, narratives, offers, and calls to action. Work with media buyers to use retention, hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS as context for creative improvements. Finish assets to a high standard: correct AI artifacts, polish color and audio, check captions and product accuracy, and export for the intended placements. Keep source files, prompts, and references organized while managing deadlines and generation costs. What you must bring A portfolio of finished DTC ecommerce ads used in paid campaigns, created for brands directly or through a performance marketing agency. Experience handling multiple brands is strongly preferred. Strong direct-response instincts: you understand how a hook leads into a product benefit, demonstration, credible proof, objection handling, and a compelling reason to buy. Expert AI production skills demonstrated in completed commercial work, including realistic UGC-style video, consistent characters and products, lip sync, voice direction, and product motion. Advanced editing, motion graphics, compositing, and sound skills. You can identify unnatural movement, weak pacing, incorrect product details, or robotic delivery and bring the work to a professional finish. Creative ownership and strong awareness of US social media culture. You can write natural English scripts, pitch original ideas, explain your decisions, and improve work through feedback and results. Professional written and spoken English, reliable remote collaboration, and availability to work the agreed full-time US Pacific schedule from LATAM. Comfortable creating content for a range of DTC brands, including sexual wellness brands. Production tools and workflow You should have an expert working setup across the categories below. We assess the quality and repeatability of your workflow; proficiency in every named application is not required. Editing and motion: Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with After Effects or comparable motion graphics and compositing tools. AI video: Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Google Veo through Flow, or comparable current platforms for controlled, realistic production. Voice and performance: ElevenLabs, plus tools such as HeyGen, Runway Act-Two, or Higgsfield lip-sync workflows. Image preparation: Photoshop and Firefly, Nano Banana, or equivalent tools for product references, storyboards, and generation inputs. Stay current, test new models, and explain which tools you choose for each brief. Show how you refine generations and combine them with precise editing to deliver finished work. What to include in your application A brief introduction, your location, and confirmation of availability during US Pacific working hours. Three to five finished videos that collectively include three DTC paid social ads, a UGC edit, a realistic AI UGC-style ad, and an AI product video with motion graphics. A sample may satisfy more than one category. For each sample, identify the product, objective, your exact contribution, and the tools used. Include available performance context and one example of how results informed an iteration. Redacted results and private portfolio links are welcome. One short workflow breakdown showing how you moved from a brief and script to generation and final edit. Include an initial AI output and the improvements you made to it. Portfolios consisting only of podcast edits, real estate videos, generic social clips, or motion graphics without DTC advertising examples do not meet this role’s requirements. Why join Lemon Adds Own creative work across DTC brands, collaborate directly with performance marketers and creatives, and help shape our AI production workflows. See your ideas tested in live campaigns and use the feedback to make your next concept stronger.

review_candidates.title: Senior Loads & Dynamics Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior Loads & Dynamics Engineer NASA Spacecraft & Launch Vehicles Kennedy Space Center, FL U.S. Citizenship is required by Federal Law We are hiring a Senior Loads & Dynamics Engineer at Kennedy Space Center, FL, to support NASA's Transportation Engineering Support (TENS) effort and Moon Base Transportation (MBT) Office. This role focuses on spacecraft and launch vehicle structural dynamics, coupled loads analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), modal analysis, vibration and acoustic testing, mechanical shock, and flight hardware qualification using NASTRAN, FEMAP, MATLAB, Python, and related engineering tools. This position supports NASA's lunar transportation initiatives through independent engineering assessments of spacecraft, payloads, launch vehicles, and integrated transportation systems. Responsibilities include evaluating structural loads, dynamic environments, analytical models, hardware test results, model correlation, and verification evidence to determine flight readiness. Candidates must bring extensive aerospace structural analysis experience and practical flight hardware testing expertise. The position may be filled at the Senior Engineer or Subject Matter Expert (SME) level based on experience and technical qualifications. Responsibilities: Perform independent technical assessments of spacecraft, payload, launch vehicle, and integrated transportation system loads and structural dynamics, including analytical methods, assumptions, models, margins, and engineering conclusions. Conduct and evaluate coupled loads analysis (CLA), finite element analysis (FEA), modal analysis, and structural dynamics assessments for aerospace flight hardware. Develop and review finite element models, evaluating mass properties, stiffness, damping, boundary conditions, load paths, interfaces, model fidelity, and sensitivities. Analyze modal, transient, frequency response, sine vibration, random vibration, acoustic, and mechanical shock environments associated with launch and spaceflight operations. Evaluate quasi-static loads, inertial acceleration (g-loads), structural responses, and dynamic amplification affecting spacecraft, payloads, components, and interfaces. Assess acoustic loading environments and test results, including sound pressure levels (SPL), frequency-dependent acoustic spectra, and structural responses. Evaluate random vibration power spectral density (PSD), acceleration responses, test tolerances, notching strategies, response limits, and qualification or acceptance criteria. Analyze mechanical shock environments using shock response spectra (SRS), time-history data, hardware response measurements, and applicable verification requirements. Identify critical structural modes, load paths, dynamic sensitivities, interface loads, acceleration levels, and potential structural failure mechanisms. Manipulate mass and stiffness matrices and develop reduced-order dynamic models using Component Mode Synthesis, Craig-Bampton reduction, and related analytical techniques. Support and independently assess flight hardware structural and environmental testing, including modal surveys, vibration, acoustic, shock, and other dynamic qualification tests. Review test requirements, plans, procedures, instrumentation, input environments, response limits, acceptance criteria, and technical reports to evaluate hardware qualification and flight readiness. Perform pre-test analytical predictions, post-test data evaluations, and structural model correlation using measured flight hardware or flight-like hardware responses. Investigate test anomalies, exceedances, unexpected structural responses, and verification discrepancies; assess root causes, hardware impacts, corrective actions, retest requirements, and flight rationale. Identify bounding test environments, critical modes, sensitive interfaces, off-nominal conditions, and potential failure modes to improve analytical and verification coverage. Develop and review structural test plans, qualification and acceptance criteria, engineering procedures, verification documentation, and technical reports. Participate in NASA technical reviews, design reviews, test readiness reviews, test activities, and engineering assessments with spacecraft providers, launch vehicle providers, and contractors. Coordinate with structures, mechanical systems, mechanisms, guidance, navigation and control (GN&C), propulsion, thermal, mission design, and systems engineering teams to evaluate integrated vehicle performance. Present technical findings, structural margins, test results, analytical sensitivities, qualification risks, and engineering recommendations to NASA and multidisciplinary program stakeholders. Use commercial and internally developed engineering analysis tools, including Python, MATLAB, C, C++, and related programming languages, to perform and automate structural dynamics analyses. Maintain configuration control, technical documentation, peer reviews, and traceability of analytical models, engineering assumptions, test data, and verification results. Travel as required to support engineering reviews, structural testing, and NASA program activities. Qualifications: U.S. Citizenship required by law or government contract Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering , Aerospace Engineering, or another applicable engineering discipline from an accredited engineering school. Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in aerospace loads analysis, structural dynamics, structural testing, finite element analysis, or spacecraft and launch vehicle structural analysis. Demonstrated experience performing or independently reviewing dynamic finite element analysis, coupled loads analysis, modal analysis, and structural dynamics assessments. Experience using structural analysis and finite element modeling software such as NASTRAN, FEMAP, or comparable engineering tools. Experience using Python, MATLAB, C, C++, or similar engineering analysis and scripting tools. Experience supporting structural or environmental testing of flight hardware or flight-like aerospace hardware, including test planning, execution, data evaluation, or analytical model correlation. Knowledge of acoustic loading, random vibration, mechanical shock, quasi-static loads, inertial acceleration environments, and aerospace structural response. Experience interpreting random vibration PSDs, shock response spectra, acoustic sound pressure levels, acceleration responses, dynamic amplification, and structural modes. Ability to independently evaluate complex analytical models, including assumptions, inputs, boundary conditions, methodologies, fidelity, sensitivities, and engineering conclusions. Ability to translate structural dynamics analyses and test results into engineering assessments of hardware risks, structural margins, qualification status, and flight readiness. Demonstrated technical judgment in evaluating complex aerospace engineering issues and independently assessing structural analysis and test evidence. Ability to communicate technically defensible engineering findings, risks, and recommendations to multidisciplinary engineering teams, customers, and program leadership. Ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines while maintaining the independent technical judgment required for objective engineering assessments. Ability to work full-time onsite at Kennedy Space Center, FL, and travel as required. Preferred Qualifications: Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering , Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Additional directly relevant aerospace loads and structural dynamics experience and demonstrated technical depth suitable for a Subject Matter Expert (SME) role. Experience analyzing spacecraft, launch vehicles, lunar landers, payloads, or other flight hardware exposed to launch and spaceflight dynamic environments. Demonstrated experience performing coupled loads analysis for spacecraft, launch vehicles, payloads, or integrated aerospace systems. Experience planning, conducting, witnessing, or independently evaluating flight hardware qualification, protoflight, and acceptance testing. Experience with modal surveys, sine vibration, random vibration, acoustic testing, mechanical shock testing, and structural model correlation. Experience developing and evaluating test input levels, response limits, vibration notching strategies, instrumentation plans, abort criteria, and acceptance criteria. Experience assessing launch acoustic environments, random vibration PSDs, shock response spectra, inertial acceleration environments, and quasi-static flight loads. Experience correlating finite element and structural dynamics models with measured test data from flight hardware or flight-like aerospace structures. Experience supporting spacecraft or launch vehicle development through design reviews, verification, qualification, acceptance testing, anomaly resolution, and flight readiness. Proficiency with MSC Nastran, Simcenter Nastran, FEMAP, or equivalent finite element and structural dynamics software. Experience with Component Mode Synthesis, Craig-Bampton reduction, superelements, and reduced-order structural modeling. Experience using multibody or nonlinear dynamic analysis software such as LS-DYNA, Adams, or comparable tools. Experience developing, customizing, or automating structural engineering analysis processes through scripting or software development. Experience independently evaluating engineering analyses, qualification testing, and verification evidence produced by spacecraft manufacturers, launch vehicle providers, or other aerospace organizations. Familiarity with NASA structural loads, dynamics, environmental testing, verification, qualification, and flight readiness practices and standards. Moseley Technical Services, Inc. is an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

review_candidates.title: Senior Engineer – Ground/Application Software Integration
review_candidates.description: Job Description The Software and Ground Solutions group at BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) is looking to expand our team with a talented and energetic software engineer focused on delivering high-quality, embedded satellite software and associated test infrastructure. This position supports a portfolio of software programs. Technology areas include software development integration and test, CI/CD, and Containerization. The Engineering, Science and Analysis (ESA) Strategic Capabilities Unit comprises the technical talent and organizational leadership that enables the successful delivery of high-impact discriminating technologies for our customers’ missions. Our collaborative, cross-functional teams are committed to innovation, integrity, continual learning and strong execution. What You’ll Do Support design, development, integration and testing of an enterprise ground system. Apply technical expertise and knowledge of satellite ground system domains to integrate custom built software applications with industry standard applications to deliver fully functional enterprise ground systems. Develop technical solutions to complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity. Interface effectively with people at all levels and from diverse areas, seek out responsibilities and opportunities to contribute, regularly meets with customers, provide leadership to groups and teams and guidance to less experienced employees. Prepare and give presentations to peers/management/customers. Support program gates as defined by customer, such as the System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and Critical Design Review (CDR). Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule. Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment. Perform other duties as necessary. On-Site Work Environment: This position requires regular in-person engagement by working on-site five days each normally scheduled week in the primary work location. Travel and local commute between company campuses and other possible non-company locations may be required. Working Conditions Work is performed in an office, laboratory, production floor, or cleanroom, outdoors or remote research environment. May occasionally work in production work centers where use of protective equipment and gear is required. May access other facilities in various weather conditions. Required Education, Experience, & Skills BS degree or higher in Engineering or a related technical field is required plus 4 or more years related experience. Each higher-level related degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of related experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education. A current, active Secret security clearance is required with ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI. Knowledge of systems engineering roles and functions, including operations concept development, requirements management, functional analysis, interface definition and control, synthesis, and/or verification and validation. Hands on experience in developing and maintaining Continuous Integration and Continuous Development (CI/CD) pipelines. Experience in cloud development environments. Experience with Agile software development methodologies. Experience with scripting languages such as Python or Ruby. Experience with Atlassian Tools such as Confluence and Jira. Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills Any experience in mission management, command & control, mission data processing, ground terminal and infrastructure domains. Knowledge of related disciplines in software engineering, hardware engineering, integration, test engineering, quality engineering, configuration/data management. Any experience with any ground or mission integration including operations readiness activities, rehearsals and launch support activities. Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) SysML diagrams (Block Diagrams, Internal Block Diagrams, State Machines, Activity Diagrams and Sequence Diagrams). Experience with requirements management tool like Jama or DOORS. Any experience with satellite operations. Pay Information Full-Time Salary Range: $97008 - $164914 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. About BAE Systems, Inc. BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support. Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

review_candidates.title: Senior Director of International Sales
review_candidates.description: JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Pfizer, Biogen, Harvard, MIT, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role JoVE is seeking a strategic, hands-on, proactive, and results-driven Senior Director of International Sales to lead our sales organizations across EMEA and APAC. Reporting to the VP of Sales, this leader will partner closely with regional sales managers to drive revenue growth through disciplined pipeline management, sales coaching, performance management, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate is an experienced sales executive with a proven track record of leading multi-country sales organizations, developing high-performing leaders and teams, and building a culture of accountability, execution, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Lead regional sales managers and their teams across EMEA and APAC, taking full ownership of revenue performance and consistently achieving quarterly and annual sales targets. Conduct weekly pipeline inspections and deal reviews to ensure pipeline quality and integrity, deal progression, forecast accuracy, and healthy pipeline coverage. Monitor and analyze key sales KPIs, including pipeline generation, meeting activity, conversion rates, forecast accuracy, and revenue attainment, and implement data-driven actions to improve performance. Drive consistent execution of JoVE's sales methodology by ensuring adoption of sales processes, CRM best practices, and operational excellence across all regions. Drive high-performance on team through effective coaching, performance management, continuous feedback, and accountability. Identify new growth opportunities by analyzing market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, territory performance, and whitespace within existing accounts. Take full ownership of regional business performance by proactively identifying execution gaps, removing obstacles, and implementing scalable initiatives that accelerate growth. Partner closely with Customer Success leadership to maximize renewals, drive expansion opportunities, strengthen account planning, and improve customer retention. Requirements A Bachelor's Degree. 10+ years of hands-on experience leading sales teams in EdTech, SaaS or STEM publishing industries. 8+ years of experience managing sales leaders, consistently achieving revenue growth targets. Strong expertise in pipeline management, forecasting, and sales performance management, with a track record of using data to drive continuous improvement and achieve business objectives. Proven ability to build, implement, and scale sales structures, processes, and strategies that drive pipeline growth and revenue performance. Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills. Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, and other sales productivity and CRM platforms. Highly results-oriented with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Benefits Base salary: €130,000-€140,000 per year (or £130,000-£140,000, depending on location). On-Target Earnings (OTE): €180,000-€190,000 per year (or £180,000-£190,000), inclusive of base salary and variable compensation at 100% target achievement. Your work will directly impact STEM teaching and learning. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.
